row.title: Deploy warnings are printed; an unreadable route list is a warning
row.body: Two runs of the unlearn upload created no host route and the run log said nothing, because it showed only the version and an unreadable route list read as no wildcard. The site deployer now warns when the zone route list cannot be read, and deploy-oidc prints the detail beside the version (test: site/oidc.test.mjs).

title: Deploy warnings are printed; an unreadable route list is a warning
